newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Wincorp to acquire Unioil stake.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Wincorp to acquire Unioil stake.

text.p: Unioil Gas & Development Co Inc said on Wednesday it has agreed to let shareholders of local firm Westmont Investment Corp (Wincorp) acquire at least 75 percent of Unioil through a share swap.
The shares are to be exchanged at a ratio of 1.54 shares of Unioil in exchange for one share of Wincorp.
Wincorp is owned by a group of Filipino investors led by banker Edgardo Espiritu.
Unioil had decided to change its primary purpose to a holding company from an oil exploration concern.
